name: Karasuyama (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Karasuyama town emblem in white: a ring with a small disc at the top, enclosing a stylised device of two curved strokes.
history: Flag of the former town of Karasuyama in Tochigi Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Karasuyama town emblem — a ring with a small disc at the top, enclosing a stylised device of two curved strokes
